decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed detached single storey garage incorporating enlargement of existing vehicular crossover and erection of 1.8m high boundary wall would fail to provide a pedestrian visibility splay from the edges of the access and as such would be detrimental to the safety of vehicles and pedestrians and be contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies T.3.5 and Revised Deposit Policies T.2.2 (January 2001) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed detached single storey garage with pitched roof, by reason of its size, position and appearance, would result in a loss of amenity to adjoining properties and  would be an intrusive addition out of scale and character with this and surrounding dwellings, and as such the proposal is contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.1.1and H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines
description: Erection of detached single storey garage to rear of property incorporating enlargement of existing vehicular crossover and erection of 108m high boundarywall.
